# Relay Inventory API - Complete Reference

Base URL: https://relayco.app

## Authentication

All requests require a bearer token sent via the `Authorization` header.

```
Authorization: Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```

### Key formats

- **Staging / Preview**: `relay_sk_test_` prefix followed by 48 hex characters
- **Production**: `relay_sk_live_` prefix followed by 48 hex characters

Staging keys are issued on non-production Vercel deployments. Production keys are issued on the production deployment. Keys are hashed with SHA-256 on the server and cannot be retrieved after creation. Sellers generate keys from Relay seller settings.

### Seller requirements

The API key must belong to a user with `role: "seller"` and `seller_application_status: "approved"`. Keys belonging to non-approved sellers return `403 seller_not_approved`.

### Response headers

Every response includes:

- `x-relay-request-id` - UUID for the request, useful for debugging and support
- `retry-after` - (only on 429 responses) seconds to wait before retrying


## Endpoints

### POST /api/integrations/inventory/upsert

Create new SKU listings or merge inventory into existing ones. Relay normalizes the SKU, enriches product data from Relay's sneaker lookup flow, saves the linked sneaker record when available, and applies the same DS/new, used, and mixed inventory rules as the listing form.

The upsert endpoint accepts either:

- `application/json`
- `multipart/form-data`

Use multipart when you want to upload the required used-condition photo as a raw file from your own tool instead of passing a public URL.

#### Request body

```json
{
  "sku": "DM7866-162",
  "condition": "New + Used",
  "box_condition": "good",
  "approximate_sizing": "normal",
  "inventory": [
    { "condition": "new", "size": "10", "quantity": 3, "price": 42000 },
    { "condition": "used", "size": "10", "price": 32500, "condition_photo_url": "https://example.com/photo1.jpg", "condition_rating": "8/10", "condition_notes": "Light heel drag" },
    { "condition": "used", "size": "10.5", "price": 30000, "condition_photo_url": "https://example.com/photo2.jpg", "condition_rating": "7/10" }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| sku | string | Single-item payload | Top-level SKU when sending one inventory payload directly |
| inventory | array | Preferred | Mixed DS/new + used row format for a single SKU payload |
| inventory[].condition | string | Yes | `new` or `used` |
| inventory[].size | string | Yes | Size label (e.g. "10", "10.5") |
| inventory[].price | number | Yes | Price for that row. Integer cents are preferred for inventory rows; decimal USD is also accepted |
| inventory[].quantity | integer | DS/new only | Required for DS/new rows. Used rows must omit quantity or set it to `1` |
| inventory[].condition_photo_url | string | Used only | Required for every used pair unless that row's photo is uploaded in multipart form data |
| inventory[].condition_rating | string | No | Optional seller-provided rating such as `8/10` |
| inventory[].condition_notes | string | No | Optional notes such as `Light heel drag` |
| items | array | Batch payload | Optional legacy/batch wrapper. Each item may use `inventory` or the older `variants` + `used_items` shape |
| items[].sku | string | Yes | Product SKU (e.g. "DZ5485-612"). Normalized to uppercase before lookup |
| items[].condition | string | No | `New`, `Used`, or `New + Used`. If omitted, Relay infers condition from row conditions |
| items[].box_condition | string | No | `perfect`, `good`, `damaged`, or `no_box`. Defaults to `perfect` |
| items[].approximate_sizing | string | No | `lightweight`, `normal`, or `heavy`. Defaults to `normal` |
| items[].description | string | No | Optional description override. Relay also enriches descriptions from sneaker lookup when available |
| condition_photo_<rowIndex> | file | Multipart single-item | Used-pair photo for inventory row `<rowIndex>` on a single top-level payload |
| condition_photo_<itemIndex>_<rowIndex> | file | Multipart batch | Used-pair photo for item `<itemIndex>`, inventory row `<rowIndex>` |

#### Response body (200)

```json
{
  "created_count": 2,
  "updated_count": 0,
  "skipped_count": 0,
  "item_errors": []
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| created_count | integer | Number of new variants created |
| updated_count | integer | Number of existing variants updated |
| skipped_count | integer | Number of variants skipped due to errors |
| item_errors | array | Per-item error objects |
| item_errors[].item_index | integer | Index of the item in the request array |
| item_errors[].row_index | integer | Inventory / used row index when the error applies to a specific row |
| item_errors[].sku | string | SKU of the failed item (if available) |
| item_errors[].field | string | Which field caused the error: "sku", "inventory", "used_items", "size", "quantity", "price", "condition", "condition_photo_url", or "item" |
| item_errors[].code | string | Machine-readable validation code such as `USED_PAIR_PHOTO_REQUIRED` |
| item_errors[].message | string | Human-readable error description |

#### Behavior

- SKU is trimmed and uppercased before lookup. "dz5485-612" and "DZ5485-612" resolve to the same listing.
- Relay keeps one SKU listing per seller. Upserting an existing SKU merges variants and used pairs into that seller's SKU listing.
- Relay checks the local `sneakers` table first and falls back to the external sneaker lookup source when needed.
- DS/new rows stay batchable by size and quantity.
- Used rows are always itemized one pair at a time.
- Every used pair requires its own `condition_photo_url` or uploaded file.
- Used rows must omit quantity or set it to exactly `1`.
- `New + Used` listings can include DS/new and used rows in the same `inventory` array.
- New listings publish gallery images only. Used and `New + Used` listings publish gallery images first, followed by the seller condition photo.
- Duplicate size + condition rows within a single item are rejected.
- Invalid rows are returned as item-level errors; valid rows in the same batch still process.

#### Multipart form-data upload

For file-based used-pair photos, send:

- `items` as a JSON string for batched requests
- `condition_photo_<rowIndex>` for a single top-level payload
- `condition_photo_<itemIndex>_<rowIndex>` for batched `items` payloads
- `condition_photo_file_<itemIndex>_<rowIndex>` as an alias field name

Example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://relayco.app/api/integrations/inventory/upsert \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -F 'items=[{"sku":"DM7866-162","condition":"New + Used","inventory":[{"condition":"new","size":"10","quantity":3,"price":42000},{"condition":"used","size":"10","price":32500}]}]' \
  -F "condition_photo_0_1=@./used-pair-10.jpg"
```

TypeScript multipart example:

```typescript
const form = new FormData();

form.append("items", JSON.stringify([
  {
    sku: "DM7866-162",
    condition: "New + Used",
    inventory: [
      { condition: "new", size: "10", quantity: 3, price: 42000 },
      { condition: "used", size: "10", price: 32500 },
    ],
  },
]));

form.append("condition_photo_0_1", fileInput.files[0]);

const response = await fetch("https://relayco.app/api/integrations/inventory/upsert", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: "Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
  },
  body: form,
});

const data = await response.json();
```

#### Error responses

- `400` ITEMS_ARRAY_REQUIRED: "Request body must include an items array or a single sku inventory payload."
- `400` SKU_REQUIRED: "SKU is required." (per item)
- `400` INVENTORY_SIZE_REQUIRED: missing size on an inventory or used row
- `400` INVENTORY_PRICE_REQUIRED: missing or invalid price on an inventory or used row
- `400` INVALID_INVENTORY_CONDITION: inventory row condition is not `new` or `used`
- `400` USED_PAIR_PHOTO_REQUIRED: used row is missing a `condition_photo_url` or uploaded file
- `400` USED_PAIR_QUANTITY_MUST_BE_ONE: used row includes quantity other than `1`


### PATCH /api/integrations/inventory/variant

Update or add one inventory row under an existing SKU listing. DS/new requests can update an existing size row or create a new DS size row. Used requests create one itemized used unit per call and always require their own condition photo.

#### Request body

```json
{
  "sku": "DM7866-162",
  "size": "10",
  "quantity": 3,
  "price": 42000,
  "active": true
}
```

Used inventory unit example:

```json
{
  "sku": "DM7866-162",
  "condition": "used",
  "size": "10.5",
  "price": 30000,
  "condition_photo_url": "https://example.com/photo2.jpg"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| sku | string | Yes | Product SKU. Normalized to uppercase. |
| size | string | Yes | Size label of the inventory row to update or create. |
| condition | string | No | `new` or `used`. Defaults to `new`. |
| quantity | integer | DS/new required | DS/new rows may use quantity >= 0. Used rows must omit quantity or set it to `1`. |
| price | number | Yes | Price for this row. Must be > 0. |
| active | boolean | No | Whether the row is available for purchase. Defaults to `true`. |
| condition_photo_url | string | Used only | Required for used rows. Every used unit needs its own condition photo. |

#### Response body (200)

```json
{
  "updated_count": 1,
  "skipped_count": 0,
  "item_results": [
    {
      "item_index": 0,
      "sku": "DM7866-162",
      "size": "10",
      "success": true,
      "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
      "variant_id": "f0e1d2c3-b4a5-6789-0abc-def123456789",
      "message": "Variant updated successfully."
    }
  ]
}
```

Used inventory unit success example:

```json
{
  "updated_count": 1,
  "skipped_count": 0,
  "item_results": [
    {
      "item_index": 0,
      "sku": "DM7866-162",
      "size": "10.5",
      "success": true,
      "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
      "used_item_id": "2a7d4ca7-30c0-42f8-b2fe-7d76310f29a8",
      "message": "Used inventory unit created successfully."
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| updated_count | integer | 1 if the variant was updated, 0 otherwise |
| skipped_count | integer | 1 if the update was skipped |
| item_results | array | Array with one result object |
| item_results[].item_index | integer | Always 0 for single variant updates |
| item_results[].sku | string | The SKU that was updated |
| item_results[].size | string | The size that was updated |
| item_results[].success | boolean | Whether the update succeeded |
| item_results[].listing_id | string | UUID of the parent listing (on success) |
| item_results[].variant_id | string | UUID of the updated variant (on success) |
| item_results[].used_item_id | string | UUID of the created used inventory unit (for used requests) |
| item_results[].message | string | Human-readable result message (on success) |
| item_results[].error | string | Error message (on failure) |

#### Behavior

- Use this endpoint only for existing SKU listings.
- DS/new requests can update an existing size row or create a new DS size row under that listing.
- Used requests always create one itemized used unit.
- Used requests must include a unique `condition_photo_url`.
- Used requests must omit quantity or set it to exactly `1`.
- Setting active to false soft-deactivates the affected row.

#### Error responses

- `400` SKU_REQUIRED: "SKU is required."
- `400` INVENTORY_SIZE_REQUIRED: "Size is required."
- `400` INVENTORY_PRICE_REQUIRED: "Price must be greater than 0."
- `400` INVALID_INVENTORY_CONDITION: condition is not `new` or `used`
- `400` USED_PAIR_PHOTO_REQUIRED: used request is missing `condition_photo_url`
- `400` USED_PAIR_QUANTITY_MUST_BE_ONE: used request sets quantity greater than `1`


### PATCH /api/integrations/inventory/prices

Reprice multiple SKU-size pairs in a single request. Only the price field is changed; quantity and active status are preserved.

#### Request body

```json
{
  "updates": [
    { "sku": "DZ5485-612", "size": "10", "price": 345 },
    { "sku": "DZ5485-612", "size": "11", "price": 355 }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| updates | array | Yes | Array of price update objects |
| updates[].sku | string | Yes | Product SKU. Normalized to uppercase. |
| updates[].size | string | Yes | Size label of the variant to reprice. |
| updates[].price | number | Yes | New price in USD. Must be > 0. |

#### Response body (200)

```json
{
  "updated_count": 2,
  "skipped_count": 0,
  "item_results": [
    {
      "item_index": 0,
      "sku": "DZ5485-612",
      "size": "10",
      "success": true,
      "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
      "variant_id": "f0e1d2c3-b4a5-6789-0abc-def123456789",
      "message": "Variant updated successfully."
    },
    {
      "item_index": 1,
      "sku": "DZ5485-612",
      "size": "11",
      "success": true,
      "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
      "variant_id": "11223344-5566-7788-99aa-bbccddeeff00",
      "message": "Variant updated successfully."
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| updated_count | integer | Number of variants successfully repriced |
| skipped_count | integer | Number that failed or were not found |
| item_results | array | Per-item result objects (same shape as variant update) |

#### Behavior

- Only price is updated. Quantity and active status remain unchanged.
- Each item is processed independently. One failure does not roll back others.
- Variants must already exist. Missing variants return success: false.

#### Error responses

- `400` invalid_request: "Request body must include an updates array."
- `400` invalid_request: "SKU is required." (per item)
- `400` invalid_request: "Size is required." (per item)
- `400` invalid_request: "Price must be greater than 0." (per item)


### POST /api/integrations/inventory/deactivate

Soft-deactivate an entire SKU listing. All size variants become unavailable for purchase without deleting order history.

#### Request body

```json
{
  "sku": "DZ5485-612"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| sku | string | Yes | Product SKU to deactivate. Normalized to uppercase. |

#### Response body (200)

```json
{
  "sku": "DZ5485-612",
  "success": true,
  "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
  "message": "Listing deactivated successfully."
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| sku | string | The SKU that was deactivated |
| success | boolean | Whether the deactivation succeeded |
| listing_id | string | UUID of the listing (on success) |
| message | string | Success message |
| error | string | Error message (on failure) |

#### Behavior

- Soft deactivation. The listing remains in the database but is no longer purchasable.
- Listings with status "removed" are excluded from lookup.

#### Error responses

- `400` invalid_request: "SKU is required."


### POST /api/integrations/inventory/deactivate-variant

Soft-deactivate a single size variant under a SKU listing. The rest of the listing remains active.

#### Request body

```json
{
  "sku": "DZ5485-612",
  "size": "10"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| sku | string | Yes | Product SKU. Normalized to uppercase. |
| size | string | Yes | Size label of the variant to deactivate. |

#### Response body (200)

```json
{
  "sku": "DZ5485-612",
  "size": "10",
  "success": true,
  "listing_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab",
  "variant_id": "f0e1d2c3-b4a5-6789-0abc-def123456789",
  "message": "Variant deactivated successfully."
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| sku | string | The SKU of the parent listing |
| size | string | The size that was deactivated |
| success | boolean | Whether the deactivation succeeded |
| listing_id | string | UUID of the parent listing (on success) |
| variant_id | string | UUID of the deactivated variant (on success) |
| message | string | Success message |
| error | string | Error message (on failure) |

#### Behavior

- Sets is_active to false on the variant. Price and quantity data are preserved.
- To reactivate, use the variant update endpoint with active: true.

#### Error responses

- `400` invalid_request: "SKU is required."
- `400` invalid_request: "Size is required."


## Error Reference

All errors return a JSON body with an `error` string field.

| Status | Code | Message | When |
|--------|------|---------|------|
| 401 | invalid_api_key | "Invalid API key." | Missing, malformed, revoked, or unrecognized bearer token |
| 403 | seller_not_approved | "Seller not approved." | API key belongs to a non-approved seller |
| 400 | invalid_json | "Request body must be valid JSON." | Request body is not parseable JSON |
| 400 | invalid_request | (varies) | Body validation failed (see per-endpoint errors above) |
| 429 | rate_limited | "Rate limit exceeded. Max 60 requests per minute per API key. Try again in N seconds." | Exceeded 60 requests in 60 seconds for this API key |
| 500 | internal_error | "Failed to process integration request." | Unexpected server error |


## Rate Limits

- 60 requests per minute per API key (sliding window)
- Exceeding returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header (seconds to wait)
- The `x-relay-request-id` response header is included on all responses


## Example Integration Flow

1. **Generate an API key**: Approved sellers create a key from Relay seller settings. The full key is shown only once.
2. **Authenticate**: Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request with `Content-Type: application/json` or multipart form data for file uploads.
3. **Create inventory**: POST to `/api/integrations/inventory/upsert` with SKUs, variant rows, and optional rich metadata. Relay enriches the product automatically and supports condition-photo file uploads for used inventory.
4. **Update prices/quantities**: Use PATCH `/api/integrations/inventory/variant` for single changes or PATCH `/api/integrations/inventory/prices` for bulk repricing.
5. **Deactivate**: POST to `/api/integrations/inventory/deactivate` for full SKU deactivation or `/api/integrations/inventory/deactivate-variant` for a single size.

### cURL example (upsert)

```bash
curl -X POST https://relayco.app/api/integrations/inventory/upsert \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -d '{
    "items": [
      {
        "sku": "DZ5485-612",
        "condition": "New + Used",
        "condition_photo_url": "https://cdn.example.com/condition/dz5485-612.jpg",
        "variants": [
          { "size": "10", "condition": "new", "quantity": 1, "price": 350 },
          { "size": "10", "condition": "used", "quantity": 1, "price": 315 },
          { "size": "11", "condition": "new", "quantity": 2, "price": 360 }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'
```

### TypeScript example (upsert)

```typescript
const response = await fetch("https://relayco.app/api/integrations/inventory/upsert", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": "Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    items: [
      {
        sku: "DZ5485-612",
        condition: "New + Used",
        condition_photo_url: "https://cdn.example.com/condition/dz5485-612.jpg",
        variants: [
          { size: "10", condition: "new", quantity: 1, price: 350 },
          { size: "10", condition: "used", quantity: 1, price: 315 },
          { size: "11", condition: "new", quantity: 2, price: 360 },
        ],
      },
    ],
  }),
});

const data = await response.json();
```

### Python example (upsert)

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://relayco.app/api/integrations/inventory/upsert",
    headers={
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Authorization": "Bearer relay_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
    },
    json={
        "items": [
            {
                "sku": "DZ5485-612",
                "condition": "New + Used",
                "condition_photo_url": "https://cdn.example.com/condition/dz5485-612.jpg",
                "variants": [
                    {"size": "10", "condition": "new", "quantity": 1, "price": 350},
                    {"size": "10", "condition": "used", "quantity": 1, "price": 315},
                    {"size": "11", "condition": "new", "quantity": 2, "price": 360},
                ],
            }
        ]
    },
)

print(response.json())
```
